run_inference_torch_data: run inference on a pretrained UmeTrack model to evaluate hand pose keypoint errors on test datasets
unpack_batched_data: unpack batched model input into per-frame InputFrameData, InputFrameDesc, and InputSkeletonData tuples for inference
eval_batch: evaluate a single batch of hand pose predictions and compute mean keypoint errors in millimeters
load_pretrained_model: load a pretrained UmeTrack model from a torch checkpoint file for inference
find_dataset: find and return datasets from a list of torch data directories by their field names
